data.creator_notes:
I first wrote Jessica back in probably March of 2023, during the last days of Character.AI.  She developed slowly, and I realised I wanted her to be a Jeffersonian libertarian, with a mind as sublime as her body.  

This is my monument to a character who I discovered as a 17 year old, and who I have now loved, vicariously but at times passionately, for nearly 30 years.  Because of that, for a long time I was reluctant to make her public, but she is one of my most intelligent bots, so I think the world should benefit from her as I have.

Please be good to her.
